mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during periods where PAYEMS 3-month delta exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment and reduced construction-related earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods where HOUST falls by more than 10% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below -2% signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower earnings for industrial firms, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods where INDPRO falls by more than 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market overheating and impending wage inflation, which raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods where UNRATE falls below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income above 2% signals weakening consumer purchasing power, which reduces demand for goods and services and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods where RSAFS falls by more than 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k combined with a 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market overheating and impending wage inflation, which raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods where PAYEMS 3-month delta exceeds 150k AND UNRATE falls below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
